text:
ash: Heads up — since the GPU canary rollout at 03:10 we see intermittent packet loss on the overlay between gpu-pool-az1 nodes. gRPC clients retrying, short spikes ~200-400ms with 1-2% packet loss.

maria: same. Noticed retransmits and fast retrans on node e2-worker-09. tcpdump shows duplicated ACKs and then a burst of dropped SYN/ACKs during the window.

sam: any recent CNI changes deployed? I didn't touch geneve config but net-setup job ran at 03:05.

ash: deploy bot shows kube-cni 1.8.2 rolled to kube-system on 03:04 — that's a potential vector.

infra-bot: kube-cni rollout completed: kube-cni:v1.8.2 -> all nodes 03:04:40 UTC.

kai: I pulled a short tcpdump from e2-worker-09 and e2-worker-11 during a spike. snippet:
```
13:18:22.123456 IP 10.10.2.9.50022 > 10.10.2.11.443: Flags [P.], seq 123:347, ack 456, win 229, length 224
13:18:22.123567 IP 10.10.2.11.443 > 10.10.2.9.50022: Flags [.], ack 347, win 512, length 0
13:18:22.123678 IP 10.10.2.9.50022 > 10.10.2.11.443: Flags [P.], seq 347:571, ack 456, win 229, length 224
13:18:22.123789 IP 10.10.2.11.443 > 10.10.2.9.50022: Flags [.], ack 571, win 512, length 0
13:18:22.124000 IP 10.10.2.9 > 10.10.2.11: icmp port unreachable
```
maria: weird: ICMP port unreachable on overlay addresses during normal TCP flow. Looks like something is dropping or NAT-ing.

sam: I ran `iperf3 -c` between the two nodes during a spike and saw RTT jump to 300ms and 1.5% packet loss. Underlying host NIC stats are fine — no rx_errors.

ash: can we check `dmesg` and `ethtool -S` on the hosts? Also check offload flags and checksum offload state for vxlan/geneve tunnels.

kai: ethtool snippet from e2-worker-09: `tx_checksummed_packets: 1245123`, `rx_checksummed_packets: 1245087`, offloads on (tx-checksumming), but I forced `ethtool -K eth0 tx off` on a test node and the packet loss reduced to 0.2% in a 5m run.

maria: that suggests skb/offsload bug with current kernel/CNI path for encapsulation. Which kernel?

sam: nodes on the pool are on kernel 5.15.78-redwood. We have a subset still on 5.15.72. Can we correlate?

ash: list of affected hosts shows majority on 5.15.78. Non-affected test hosts on 5.15.72. Looks correlated.

kai: I opened a quick trace with `bcc` to see GSO/GSOSPlice usage — lots of gso packets for VXLAN path. When I disabled GSO (`sysctl net.core.gso_max_size=0`) test traffic stabilized.

maria: do we have RDMA in these racks? Should be on for some GPU jobs, but not used for pod traffic. Could RDMA HCA driver interactions affect offloads?

sam: yes Mellanox HCA present on az1 racks. There was a firmware update two weeks ago but we haven't seen issues until now — maybe kernel + CNI + firmware combination.

ash: Plan: 1) Roll back kube-cni on a canary subset to v1.8.1 + disable GSO on hosts, 2) replace offload config in CNI to force `no-gso` for vxlan interfaces, 3) gather perf traces for vendor. Anyone object?

maria: +1. Also capture `tc qdisc` state and `ss -s` before/after. I'll script the captures.

sam: I'll prep a small canary (3 nodes) and coordinate rollback window 04:00 UTC. Keep GPU jobs out of the canary nodes.

kai: I will also file infra-ticket with Mellanox driver + kernel team. include tcpdump, ethtool outputs, offload toggles, and test results showing GSO disable reduces loss.

ash: temporary mitigations: disable tx-checksum/gso for vxlan on all gpu-pool hosts via daemonset until patch. That buys time for minimal disruption. Can we deploy as a node daemonset that runs `ethtool -K`?

maria: yes, I can author a ds. Will include liveness guard to revert.

infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-3145: "Intermittent overlay packet loss correlated with offload/GSO on kernel 5.15.78". Assigned to kai, priority P1, linked to deploy plan.

sam: One more note — rolling rollback may impact a few long-running training jobs. We'll throttle and use drain with `--ignore-daemonsets` to move pods slowly. Notify ML infra.

ash: ping @ml-platform to expect brief reschedules. Also monitoring: add a Grafana alert for >0.8% packet loss on vxlan host iface for 3m.

maria: I'll push the daemonset manifest and a runbook snippet to the ticket. Runbook includes: checks, commands to toggle offloads, how to revert, how to verify with `iperf3` and `tcpdump`.

kai: filing upstream bug report to vendor and kernel: include `bpftrace` logs showing GSO handling at SKB layer, will attach to INFRA-3145.

ash: good work team — small, surgical rollback + offload toggle. Keep thread updated with verification numbers. :thumbsup:

maria: quick verify numbers after ds deploy on canary: before: 1.8% loss, avg RTT 210ms. after disable: 0.12% loss, avg RTT 13ms. Sharing payload + graphs in ticket.

sam: starting rollback window in 10m. I'll update when done.

ash: thanks — will await final verification and then plan wider rollout or vendor patch.
